title: Poisoner's Gloves
summary: When you deal Poison damage, the target can become Poisoned.

fields.Envenom: Each qualifying Poison damage instance calls for a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure, the target is Poisoned for 3 turns, with disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
fields.Interaction: Envenom applies the general Poisoned condition and can trigger the Derivation Cloak’s 1d4 self-heal.
fields.Acquisition: Chest at the back of House of Healing, X −199, Y 78.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
